title: Fungus Seed

{{{{{1|Seeds Infobox}}} |image = Fungus Seed |Crop = Monster Mushroom |Growth = 13 days |Season = {{Season|Fall}} |Sell Price = 0 |gPrice = ''Not sold'' |jPrice = ''Not sold'' |tPrice = ''Not sold'' }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' are a type of seed that can be planted in the {{Season|Fall}}. Mature plants yield [[Monster Mushroom]] after 13 days. Seeds cannot be purchased, but they can be obtained by eliminating [[Highlands Sprite|Highlands Sprites]] and by placing Monster Mushroom in the [[Stardew:Seed maker|Seed Maker]]. Mature plants yield a single Monster Mushroom per harvest, with a 5% chance of extra harvest per [[Stardew:Farming#Farming Skill|Farming Skill]] level. ==Summary== {{#lst:Crop Summaries|Monster Mushroom}} {{clear}}
